pieces.Text: When you're fully graviton-attuned, you can call creatures of intense gravity to fight for you as a standard action. This functions as summon creature (Alien Archive 144) with a spell level equal to one-third your solarian level. You select which four creatures you can summon each time you gain a solarian level, and they must all be shadow creatures. Creatures you summon with this ability gain the Coordinated Shot feat.
